source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: At the opening of either [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), you may pay 1 **Pain token** to make this unit [Empowered](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain). While [Empowered](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain), roll one D6 whenever a melee attack destroys one of its models before that model has fought in the phase. A 2+ delays removal. The casualty may fight once the attacking unit finishes its attacks, then is removed.

effect.trigger: each model in recipient destroyed by melee attack

success.timing: after attacker unit finishes its attacks
